name: teams
description: List all AFL teams tracked by Squiggle, optionally filtered to a specific year; returns team IDs, names, and abbreviations used across other tools.

name: games
description: Fetch AFL fixture and results from Squiggle, filtered by year, round, and/or completion status; returns scores, venues, dates, and match IDs.

name: standings
description: Fetch the AFL ladder (standings) for a given year and optional round from Squiggle; returns wins, losses, points, and percentage for each team.

name: sources
description: List all registered AFL tipping sources in Squiggle (models, pundits, bookmakers) with their numeric IDs; use IDs with `tips` and `ladder`.
